Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

Expansion should start close to home, not nationwide. # Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

Expansion should start close to home, not nationwide. The first counties are the Central-PA core around the Lancaster hub, then Chester County PA, New Castle County DE and the Jersey Shore counties, where the top-ranked tuck-ins sit (Punctual Pros add-on targets; Punctual Pros nationwide plan). A true national county ranking cannot be produced from the excerpt provided.

## Why Not Nationwide Yet

- The growth plan sequences expansion in phases. A national consolidator role inside the One Hour / Ben Franklin / Mister Sparky system is Phase 4 (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Phase 1 (months 0-12) fills the 248 core Central-PA ZIPs and the 195 best nearby ZIPs (144 PA, 51 MD). It also closes 1-2 tuck-ins.
- The sponsor cases support this order. The median first add-on came about 7 months after entry, and it was close to home (value creation cases).

## First-Wave Counties

| County / area | State | Anchor target | Fit score | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lancaster (hub) | PA | Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | 84 | 1 |
| Chester | PA | West Chester tri-brand (Ron Williams group) | 82 | 1-2 |
| Monmouth, Middlesex, Somerset, Union, Essex | NJ | C&C Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing & Electric | 82 | 2 |
| Mechanicsburg area | PA | Zimmerman Plumbing, Heating & Air | 80 | 1 |
| Pleasantville area (South Jersey) | NJ | PHE / The Punctual Pros NJ | 80 | 2 |

(Punctual Pros add-on targets)

- **Worcester County, MD.** The Delmarva franchise has the same owner as West Chester, so one deal could open both areas.
- **New Castle County, DE.** The Wilmington / Dover operator is a 1991 founder business (Punctual Pros add-on targets).
- **Phase 3 metros (months 18-36).** These are Baltimore-DC, Richmond, the Philadelphia suburbs and Pittsburgh (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- **Est. scale.** The plan models 25 territories today, 32 at month 12 and 44 at month 24. These figures are labeled assumptions (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

## What the Data Cannot Show

- The national county base table (generated Oct 6, 2026) is truncated in this context. No county scores or rankings are visible.
- A ranked national list would need these fields from that table for each county:
  - owner-occupied housing units
  - heating and cooling degree days
  - Redfin housing-market fields
  - Authority Brands territory counts
  - distance to the Lancaster hub
- **Connecticut gap.** For CT counties, the degree-day, Redfin and Authority fields are null (national counties). Any CT scoring would be incomplete.
- **Revenue gap.** Target revenue and headcount are mostly missing because ZoomInfo enrichment was unavailable (Punctual Pros add-on targets).

## Next Actions

1. Pull the full national county table. Score every county in PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY, then cross-check the scores against the 54 unowned Authority territories.
2. Open owner conversations with Lancaster Plumbing and the Ron Williams group. The Ron Williams group covers both Chester County and Delmarva.
3. Fill the missing revenue and employee data for the top 10 targets before any valuation work.
4. Build a short list of Phase 3 counties for Baltimore-DC and the Philadelphia suburbs, ready for review at the month-12 checkpoint.
